_about: Fictional chats from Night Guard's evaluation set (eval/conversations.jsonl, ids r01, r09, r07, r35), with an app, a contact name and a child name added for the demo. 'labels' are the hand labels of that set, with the exact quote and message index; the replay backend returns them as the model answer so the demo runs without any model.
